name: @wc-toolkit/cem-generator-lit
reason: Preserve source types/defaults/visibility while supplementing Lit metadata and retain attribute inheritance origins. Converter types do not override authored types. Preserve inherited constructor overrides, declare-only defaults and inherited/attribute documentation. Keep explicitly authored attribute ownership separate from inherited backing-field ownership. Optional semantic class and framework-boundary hooks allow the adapter to bind renamed/namespace Lit imports to actual compiler declarations; default detection remains unchanged. Add reviewed own-constructor extraction and provenance bindings for the separately qualified composition tier; preserve the ordinary production route. Bind event dispatch to original compiler-owned receiver and constructor identity. Retain direct JSDoc ownership and source scope in shared parsing.
